title: Read an earlier tool result
description: Read the full result of an earlier tool call by its handle (e.g. "@tool:14"), optionally narrowed to one part with a jsonPath like "$.stdout" or "$.items[0].name". Use this instead of repeating a call whose result was truncated.

handle.description: The handle from a previous tool result, e.g. "@tool:14".

jsonPath.description: Optional path into the result, e.g. "$.stdout" or "$.items[0].name". Omit for the whole result.

maxChars.description: Optional cap on how much comes back (default 10000).

examples: read the rest of the command output
get the full response body from @tool:14
